name: Post-flush stabilization entry (15m long, ATR-compression confirmation)
rationale: MECHANISM (H4 with an ATR-compression arm replacing realized-vol): the honest signature of 'the flush is over' is that the true-range CONTRACTS after the cascade spike — an ATR relative to its post-flush low confirms the violent selling has drained. Waiting for that contraction isolates the confirmed-basing subset. Counterparty: late dip-sellers hitting bids after forced flow is gone. Entry: open_interest below a floor (flush occurred) AND range_position cross_up through a low floor (lifting off lows) AND rsi cross_up through an oversold-exit level (curling up) AND atr below a ceiling (true-range compressing post-flush). DISCONFIRMER: ablate against H1 on the same sample — no tail/maxDD improvement means the wait is pure lag; and range_position cross_up alone (no OI) matching means generic bottom-fishing. The ATR arm must add real separation (drop it — if no degradation, it is cosmetic). Beat buy-and-hold net of fees.
catalyst: post-flush basing with ATR (true-range) compressing — the cascade is confirmed drained
